workItems.title: Keep local update files option
workItems.description: Introduces a configuration option in the INI-file Editor allowing administrators to control whether update files remain in the client's update image folder after a server update.
acceptanceCriteria: Configuration option is available in the INI-file Editor.
Administrators can enable or disable the setting.
Behaviour is verified during update installation.

linkedCase.customerIssue: Administrators requested improved control over update files.
linkedCase.resolution: Added configuration option within the INI-file editor.

workItems.title: Time converter functionality
workItems.description: Adds time conversion functionality to the T-DOC Machine Profile Editor to simplify configuration tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can convert time values directly in the editor.

linkedCase.resolution: Time converter added to Machine Profile Editor.

workItems.title: Cancel or Force start picking jobs
workItems.description: Allows administrators to cancel or force-start automated picking jobs managed by third-party scheduling systems.

linkedCase.customerIssue: Administrators required better control of automated picking jobs.
linkedCase.resolution: Added Cancel and Force Start actions.

workItems.title: Auto show content list setting
workItems.description: Adds an Auto Show Content List option allowing operators to scan a load tag and immediately display unit content information.
acceptanceCriteria: Load tag scanning displays unit contents.

linkedCase.customerIssue: Operators requested easier access to distribution and content information.
linkedCase.resolution: Added Auto Show Content List and Distribution Information enhancements.
linkedCase.customerImpact: Improves visibility of production and distribution data.

workItems.title: Distribution Information Overview
workItems.description: Enhances the Distribution Information Overview by displaying the selected tag ID for each customer.

linkedCase.customerIssue: Operators requested easier access to distribution and content information.
linkedCase.resolution: Added Auto Show Content List and Distribution Information enhancements.
linkedCase.customerImpact: Improves visibility of production and distribution data.
